name: Boltz API
description: The official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the Boltz API. Predict molecular structures and binding interactions, screen small-molecule and protein libraries against a target, and design small molecules and protein binders — all from chat. Each workflow estimates cost before running, then downloads structured results to your workspace when the job completes.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Boltz API to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Boltz API to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.boltz.bio/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Boltz API MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Boltz API provides these MCP tools: boltz_estimate_protein_screen, boltz_estimate_small_molecule_screen, boltz_estimate_structure_and_binding, boltz_get_guidance, boltz_get_job_status, boltz_get_screen_results, boltz_get_structure_and_binding_prediction, boltz_start_protein_screen, boltz_start_small_molecule_screen, and boltz_start_structure_and_binding.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Boltz API?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Boltz API in life-sciences on the Manufact MCP catalog include AdisInsight, Helix GenoSphere, Inductive Bio, LatchBio, and Owkin.

_published_faq.name: Does Boltz API MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Boltz API requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Boltz API is developed by Boltz. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
